text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (specifically Salt-Wasting or Simple Virilizing form due to CYP21A2 deficiency). The combination of ambiguous genitalia at birth, maternal hirsutism, severe acne, delayed menarche, and bone fragility is classic for untreated or partially treated CAH causing androgen excess and suppression of the HPG axis. I recommend immediate testing of 17-hydroxyprogesterone levels and a karyotype to confirm.
